subject: gov.policy
name: National Digital Transformation Agenda 2022-2025
milestone: Four axes set out by the digital minister; the period has since ended
position_start: In force, in its final years
position_end: Its period has ended and no successor agenda is held
sources: 2023-11-27 Setting the agenda for digital transformation

subject: gov.policy
name: Ride-hailing authorisation compliance deadline
milestone: Fifteen-day deadline set by communique of 21 August 2026
position_end: The road transport regulator gave ride-hailing companies operating through digital applications 15 days to bring their authorisations into line with the law, in a communique reported as published on 21 August 2026 and warning that failure within the deadline could bring legal proceedings including suspension of the activity, with no further notice or warning required; the regulator set the warning against growing use of digital platforms for transport services
note: no operator is named and no count of non-compliant authorisations is given

subject: gov.legislate
name: ANETA state digital agency proposal
milestone: Named 'Agence Numérique de l'État' (AN-État) and proposed as national interoperability operator in a June 2023 strategy, reviving a 2021 UNDP proposal
position_end: Proposed by UNDP (31 July 2021) as an EPA under the digital ministry with about 50 staff, EUR 220,000 to set up and EUR 1.4m a year to run, and a draft creation decree; a June 2023 open-data strategy proposes reviving that decree to name the same body national interoperability operator; no adoption, decree or launch is on record
note: whether the 2023 strategy's 'AN-État' is the same proposal as 2021's ANETA is not stated explicitly, but the acronym, mandate and sponsoring ministry match

subject: gov.legislate
name: Startup Act
milestone: Loi n° 2024-002 P.R relative aux start-ups technologiques et innovantes promulgated 2 January 2024
position_start: Draft bill in public consultation, targeting 300 labelled start-ups and 3,000 jobs over five years
position_end: Enacted 2 January 2024; the promulgated text is not held, but the ministry's pre-enactment deck sets out a merit-based label with a preferential public-procurement margin (Article 13), a state-backed start-up fund and guarantee fund with investor tax incentives (Article 21), payroll-cost relief and a technology-innovation hub, and IP and customs relief
note: the promulgated text of Loi n° 2024-002 itself is not held

subject: gov.legislate
name: Universal Service Access Fund governance
milestone: Council of Ministers approved a decree repealing Decree 2020-152
position_end: A replacement decree approved on grounds that the fund's object, its resource mobilisation and allocation, and its integration into the state budgetary system were all unclear; the new terms are not published
note: neither the new decree nor the one it repeals is held; both national gazette hosts return NXDOMAIN

subject: gov.protect
name: Data protection authority
milestone: Operating under a 2023-2026 plan, per a reference guide
position_end: Established; no decision, register, enforcement action or annual report is held

subject: gov.protect
name: Data protection law and enforcement record
milestone: Loi n° 2017-020 in force since 22 July 2017; the authority reports monthly meetings and sector sensitisation days through May 2026
position_end: In force since 22 July 2017, requiring APD-approved codes of conduct and free, unambiguous consent for personal-data processing, covering both manual and electronic processing; the authority runs monthly ordinary meetings and sensitisation days for ministries, telecom operators and financial institutions; no enforcement decision, register entry, sanction or annual report is published
note: the OCR extraction of the law cuts off mid-Article 2; later chapters covering processing conditions, the APD's powers and sanctions are not captured

subject: gov.regional
name: Arab Maghreb Union treaty
milestone: Concluded at Marrakesh, 17 February 1989
position_end: In force since 1 July 1989 with a binding judicial organ, and no summit held since 1994 - a legal frame for regional harmonisation with no active machinery behind it

subject: gov.regional
name: Senegal-Mauritania digital cooperation memorandum
milestone: Signed January 2025
position_end: Signed; no deliverable, workstream or funding under it is on record

subject: gov.standards
name: National framework for public digital service standards
milestone: Three-day standards and interoperability workshop run by the digital ministry
position_end: Under development with German support through GIZ and the Digital-Y project; no framework or standard has been published

subject: gov.standards
name: National IPv6 transition strategy
milestone: A 68-page strategy targeting 25% adoption by 2026, with a national committee
position_start: In force, with a 25% by 2026 target and a national transition committee
position_end: In force; the target is unmet with the deadline approaching
note: the strategy carries no printed adoption date and its sector economic-impact figures are lifted from a consultancy report and cited rather than measured

subject: gov.standards
name: Technical assistance on public finance statistics and state-enterprise debt
milestone: Mission received 3 September 2026
position_end: The finance minister received an International Monetary Fund technical assistance mission on public finance statistics and state-owned enterprise debt, led by a regional public finance statistics adviser with the fund's resident representative present. It works on strengthening compilation in line with the 2014 government finance statistics manual, and discussions reviewed progress, results so far and next steps on the collection, reliability and consolidation of state-owned enterprise financial data
note: no baseline, target or publication commitment is stated for the state-enterprise debt data the mission is working on, so what is currently held about it stays unknown

subject: finance.budget
name: Digital ministry budget
position_end: US$24.2m for 2026, up 104.6% on the previous year

subject: finance.mou
name: Islamic Development Bank digital financing
milestone: Agreement in principle for US$50m, 14 April 2026
position_end: Agreed in principle for US$50m covering digital infrastructure, cybersecurity, interoperability and skills; no signed instrument, disbursement or schedule is held

subject: finance.new
name: Digital-Y German cooperation project
milestone: Supporting the public digital service standards framework
position_end: Running; supporting the standards framework, with no output or completion report published

subject: finance.new
name: EIB COVID-19 resilience submarine cable financing
milestone: Committed in 2020
position_end: Committed; no completion or outcome report is held

subject: finance.new
name: EIB financing for the EllaLink connection
milestone: More than EUR 43.5m committed by the EIB and the EU
position_end: Committed; the cable is not yet commissioned

subject: finance.new
name: WARDIP digital transformation programme
milestone: Financed the national cloud launched in June 2026
position_start: Under implementation, with the national PKI procurement and cloud build outstanding
position_end: The national cloud launched under it; the PKI procurement remains unawarded

subject: finance.new
name: World Bank private sector, digital and human capital reform financing
milestone: US$30m IDA grant, the second of three operations
position_end: Disbursed; no third operation is on record
sources: 2021-06-22 Mauritania Second Private Sector, Digital and Human Capital Reform DPF (P171238, World Bank)|2021-07-22-wb-mrt-001-mauritania-2nd-second-private-sector-digital

subject: infra.connect
name: 5G licences
milestone: Commercial network launched at Nouakchott 2026-08-10
position_start: Did not exist; the process opened on 2 December 2025
position_end: Four fifteen-year licences to Mauritel, Mattel, Chinguitel and the new entrant Rimatel, bids of MRU 252.6m to 305m plus 5% of revenue; Chinguitel launched the country's first commercial 5G network in Nouakchott on 10 August 2026, no coverage footprint or subscriber figure published The second operator launched its network at Nouakchott on 10 August 2026 under the digital transformation minister; no coverage, tariff or subscriber figure is stated.
note: the award broke the three-operator structure

subject: infra.connect
name: ACE submarine cable landing
milestone: Sole international cable since 2011
position_end: The country's only international cable in service

subject: infra.connect
name: Chinguitel network modernisation
milestone: Full modernisation completed in Nouakchott with Huawei
position_end: Completed; no coverage, capacity or subscriber figure was published with it

subject: infra.connect
name: EllaLink second submarine cable
milestone: Phase-1 coastal landing completed at Nouadhibou
position_start: Project launched at Nouadhibou in July 2025: 669 km, 200 Gb/s rising to 12 Tbit/s, EIB and EU financed
position_end: Phase-1 coastal landing complete at Nouadhibou, offshore laying scheduled for August 2026 and commissioning expected in the first quarter of 2027
sources: 2026-05-04-ellalink-second-cable-phase1-landing-ami|2025-07-28-ellalink-second-cable-launch-ami|2026-05-23 Orange-backed subsea cable to connect Nigeria, 19 other countries

subject: infra.connect
name: IPv6 deployment across operator networks
milestone: All licensed operators have activated IPv6 across networks and services
position_start: Adopted as a strategy in 2024 with no operator activation reported
position_end: All operators have activated IPv6, with one unnamed operator past 15% of subscribers migrated (2026-07) against a 25% end-2026 target

subject: infra.connect
name: MEDUSA cable, sub-Saharan component
milestone: EIB financing recorded for the sub-Saharan component
position_start: Financed, with no landing on record
position_end: Financed; no landing, route or commissioning date is on record

subject: infra.connect
name: Sahel digital connectivity support
milestone: Ericsson with Luxembourg and Swedish support named for Sahel connectivity
position_end: Announced; no site, capacity or delivery figure for Mauritania is published

subject: infra.connect
name: Satellite internet licences
milestone: Three firms provisionally selected across two lots
position_start: Did not exist; the tender opened on 22 January 2026
position_end: BRAINSAT, VDM and Mattel provisionally retained from nine bids, with VDM and Mattel required to match BRAINSAT's offer; no award, launch date or operating framework published
note: thirteen firms took the dossier; BRAINSAT bid US$800,000 for the mobile lot and US$3m for capacity, VDM US$50,000 and Mattel MRU 6.5m. The regulator's own communique is not held; the figures reach the wiki through Agence Ecofin's account of it

subject: infra.store
name: National cloud platform
milestone: Data-security testing and migration preparation ahead of go-live, 2026-08-11
position_end: Launched to host government data and services domestically and centralise public IT; no migration timeline, capacity or cost disclosed As at 11 August 2026 the donor-funded national government cloud was in data-security testing and migration preparation ahead of go-live.

subject: infra.store
name: Nouakchott Tier III national data centre
milestone: Inaugurated 8 May 2025, EUR 15m EIB-financed and Uptime-certified
position_start: In service, operated by International Mauritania Telecom
position_end: In service; no capacity, utilisation or migration figure has been published since
sources: 2025-05-08 Mauritania - Nouakchott data centre inaugurated (EIB)|2025-08-20 Construction of a Datacenter in Nouakchott, Mauritania (EEAS)

subject: infra.energy
name: Power supply to network sites and the data centre

subject: infra.energy
name: SOMELEC digital-transformation programme
milestone: FY2024 procurement plan (revised 4 December 2024) itemises a data-centre fit-out, an ERP/CRM system and smart-metering and dispatch studies, each with a target completion date
position_end: A FADES-financed data-centre fit-out (launched July 2023, due October 2024), a FADES+SOMELEC-financed ERP and CRM system with infrastructure (in procurement, due June 2025), a second IDA-financed ERP study (due December 2025), an IDA-financed geo-referenced database for the national electrification strategy with server-operations training (due October 2025), and IDA-financed advanced-metering and national-dispatch studies (due October-November 2025); two telecoms engineers recruited under AfDB financing; no item is reported complete
note: SOMELEC's own data centre, distinct from the government's Nouakchott national data centre and national cloud

subject: infra.cybersec
name: Central Bank digital reputation protection platform
milestone: Detection figures for the first half of 2026 reported by PAFIID
position_end: Operating with AI support: more than 10,000 electronic threats detected in the first half of 2026, of which 470 were confirmed and removed, and 20 digital identities protected

subject: infra.cybersec
name: National computer emergency response team
milestone: Provided for under the 2022-2025 cybersecurity strategy; nothing on record built
position_end: Planned; no establishing instrument, staffing or premises is on record

subject: infra.cybersec
name: National Cybersecurity Strategy 2022-2025
milestone: Ran 2022 to 2025; no successor is published
position_start: In its final year, with a CERT planned
position_end: Its period has ended and no successor, evaluation or CERT is on record
note: recorded by a reference guide; the strategy text is not held

subject: dpi.exchange
name: National data management system
milestone: Two-day workshop opened on data governance and blockchain, 27 July 2026
position_end: Being scoped for inter-administration integration with blockchain proposed as its trust layer, on a national blockchain policy in consultation since November 2025 naming land administration, trade, public procurement and natural-resource management; no draft text, adoption date or budget published

subject: dpi.id
name: Biometric SIM identification
milestone: Formal notices issued to the three operators, January 2026
position_start: Deactivation of non-biometric SIMs ordered in October 2023, with compliance not established
position_end: Formal notices to Mattel, Mauritel and Chinguitel with a two-month deadline before sanctions of up to 3% of turnover; no compliance outcome is on record
sources: 2026-01-16 Mauritania Steps Up Pressure on Telecom Operators Over Biometric Identification

subject: dpi.id
name: Houwiyeti digital identity application
milestone: A full day of scheduled maintenance took the application down, 2026-08-08
position_start: Launched in 2024 on the TECH5 platform, carrying document extracts and passport requests
position_end: In use by about 1.5 million citizens for 554,027 remote services, and the identity-verification backbone for the state services portal's fifteen-plus services and for private financial applications; a full day of scheduled maintenance on 8 August took all of it down at once
sources: 2026-08-11-mauritania-houwiyeti-outage-digital-sovereignty|2026-06-21-houwiyeti-usage-metrics-techrek|2024-08-15 Mauritania Launches Digital ID for e-Services, Built on TECH5 Platform (Houwiyeti)|2024-08-02 Mauritania launches digital ID app to boost access to services and improve governance|2024-08-01 Mauritania pilots digital ID app (e-ID Mauritania)|2023-08-18-anrpts-passport-demand-20000-2020-to-94000-2023
note: a 70% passport-request claim made in May 2025 does not reconcile with ANRPTS's own passport volumes and is not used; the usage figures are the reporting outlet's, and no operator statement on the outage or on redundancy is held

subject: dpi.id
name: National Population Register
milestone: Register figures given to deputies, June 2026
position_start: More than 94% of the population reported enrolled since 2020
position_end: 5.1m on the register against 3.4m in 2019, with more than 1.7m new enrolments, over 613,000 captured by a difficulties survey and 238 local commissions installed; enrolment is now a permanent public service under the 2025 reform
sources: 2026-06-18-etat-civil-parliamentary-id-exclusion-ladepeche|2025-05-20 African nations making digital ID gains in the face of common challenges (ID4Africa 2025)
note: a contested residual of citizens without papers falls disproportionately on Haratine and Afro-Mauritanian groups and sits in tension with the aggregate coverage claim

subject: dpi.id
name: National public key infrastructure and certificate management system
milestone: Bid deadline moved to 21 July 2026 by a second addendum
position_end: Tendered in two lots under World Bank credit and twice extended, with evaluation reweighted to 40% technical and 60% cost; no award is held
note: the notice title promises a national digital identity system but the operative text describes only e-certification integrating with the existing register

subject: dpi.pay
name: PAMIF financial infrastructure modernisation
milestone: Telecompensation, real-time settlement and automated refinancing reported delivered
position_end: Financial inclusion at 55% in 2026 on the financier's own account, with BMCI transfers rising from 5,000 in the whole of 2023 to 94,000 in the second half of 2025; a second phase targets a fintech ecosystem
note: the figures are the African Development Bank's account of its own US$4.78m project

subject: dpi.pay
name: Tax on electronic transactions
milestone: Introduced by the 2026 finance law
position_end: In force at 0.1% on electronic transactions above MRU 5,000 and 10% on agent commissions, collected at source

subject: dpi.registry
name: Biometric driving licences and registration plates
milestone: Ministerial statement of a before-end-2026 target, 2026-08-21
position_end: The equipment and transport minister stated that driving licences and vehicle registration plates would be digitised and issued in biometric form before the end of 2026, alongside continued reform of the land transport directorate
note: a stated target; no procurement, supplier or system specification is published

subject: dpi.registry
name: National information system for the central criminal-record register
milestone: Decree adopted by the Council of Ministers 2026-08-27
position_end: A decree adopted to build a secured national information system centralising, standardising and continuously updating criminal-record data, wiring courts, prosecution offices and the competent central services together electronically, allowing interoperability with related information systems and fixing responsibility for data entry and updating
note: presented by the justice minister; no build timetable, budget or operator is stated

subject: dpi.registry
name: Referentiel national numerique des donnees foncieres et cadastrales
milestone: Digitisation critiqued publicly 2026-08-28
position_start: No integrated cadastral survey system meeting these requirements
position_end: the digital cadastral reference enacted, and publicly criticised as a route to silent dispossession in a country where land is at the heart of social conflict
note: aligned to ordonnance 83-127 of 5 June 1983, the code des droits reels and personal-data protection law; the decree states expressly that neither the reference nor the cadastral certificate creates, alters or extinguishes any real property right

subject: dpi.registry
name: Rural land concession registration platform
milestone: Registration window open to 18 September 2026
position_end: The technical committee on the rural land and developer-plot allocation file called on all holders of rural land concessions inside the capital's urban zone to register on a national platform, running to 18 September 2026 with staffed help desks in the capital's three moughataas, following a declaration presented to the Council of Ministers on 28 April 2026
note: a two-week window with a hard deadline and no stated consequence for holders who miss it, no expected registration count and no description of what the platform does with a registration once made

subject: dpi.registry
name: Unified digital consular registry
milestone: Live for the Riyadh mission's zone of competence
position_end: Live for Saudi Arabia, Bahrain and the Maldives, registering residence, geographic distribution and permitted activities and building a digital register of national skills abroad
note: the consular registration desk remains the competent authority, so the platform layers onto the registry rather than replacing it

subject: dpi.mis
name: Education certificate service on Houwiyeti
milestone: Launched for extraction and confirmation of national education certificates
position_start: In service for certificates issued after 2013 or linked to the national identity number
position_end: In service; no usage figure is held

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Digital consular services platform
milestone: Launched 9 July 2026 with a first phase of nine online services
position_end: Live, delivering consular registration, the consular card, travel authorisation, legalisation, powers of attorney, appointments and burial and repatriation permits without attending the mission
note: built by diaspora engineers with the digital ministry after consultations in 22 countries

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Digitised civil service recruitment competition
milestone: Four-day examination for 390 posts opened 2026-08-18
position_end: Candidate files filed through the state services platform for a four-day examination covering 390 civil service posts, part of a wider competition for 3,000 state employees and contract workers, run by the competitions commission with the digital transformation ministry
note: no application count, rejection rate or accessibility provision for candidates without connectivity is published

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Digitised civil-service recruitment
milestone: 390-post competition run digitally from application to examination (2026-08)
position_end: Applications filed through the Khadematy platform and examinations sat on digital tablets at Nouakchott, for a 390-post competition inside a wider 3,000-post programme
note: the first competition the base holds that is digital end to end rather than at the application stage only; no candidate count, marking method, accessibility provision or fallback for a candidate unable to use a tablet is published, and nothing states how the results are audited

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Electronic invoicing for public institutions
milestone: Announced by the Finance Minister, 30 July 2026
position_end: Announced, to handle VAT and withholding at source by transferring data automatically to the tax directorate; no instrument, supplier or date published

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Ijraati administrative procedures portal
milestone: Launched consolidating more than 800 administrative procedures
position_end: Live as a directory of more than 800 procedures with documents, processing times, agencies and tracking; no usage figure published
sources: 2026-02-22 Mauritania Centralizes 800 Administrative Procedures in New Digital Portal (Ijraati)

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Khdamati remote transactions platform
milestone: Integration with the Diwan territorial-administration system taken forward with German cooperation 2026-08-13
position_end: Named in a roadmap and now the subject of integration work with the Diwan territorial-administration system, discussed on 2026-08-13 with the German embassy's charge d'affaires and GIZ's resident director as part of decentralisation and local-development cooperation; no build, date or scope is published
sources: 2026-08-13-mauritania-diwan-khidmaty-digitalization-german-cooperation|2026-02-22 Mauritania Centralizes 800 Administrative Procedures in New Digital Portal (Ijraati)
note: Diwan itself is not separately held; the integration is reported as under discussion, not delivered

subject: dpi.govtech
name: SNDE services on the Mes Services portal
milestone: Water utility services integrated into the portal from 4 August 2026
position_end: Live, with the utility's transactions available remotely; German cooperation was credited without an amount, instrument or term, and no usage figure exists

subject: dpi.govtech
name: STT electronic tax services platform
milestone: Adoption by public bodies disclosed at a tax workshop, 30 July 2026
position_end: Live, with 66 public bodies enrolled, 53 filing electronically and 3 paying through it, against 642 legally constituted public bodies of which 339 are active with the tax administration
note: around 20 public bodies are absent from the national taxpayer register; more than 500 taxpayers overall are on the tax directorate's electronic platform, producing 36.45% of directorate revenue in 2026

subject: tech.ai
name: National AI Strategy 2025-2029
milestone: Recorded by a reference guide; the text is not held
position_start: Recorded as existing, the text not held
position_end: Recorded as existing; nothing establishes its scope, commitments, budget or implementing body

subject: tech.industry
name: Mobile operator market
milestone: A fourth operator entered at the 5G award
position_start: Three licensed operators: Mauritel, Mattel and Chinguitel
position_end: Four, with the new entrant Rimatel licensed alongside the three incumbents

subject: capacity.training
name: Summer school on language models for low-resource African languages
milestone: First edition opened 2026-08-25
position_end: First edition opened at Nouadhibou by the University of Nouakchott, taking participants through corpus construction and semantic annotation, model adaptation, training and evaluation, and on to prototypes in translation and conversational assistants
note: no participant count, budget or repeat commitment is stated; a German development agency spoke at the opening

subject: capacity.training
name: Youth digital employability programme
milestone: Launched for 2,150 beneficiaries across six cities, 23 July 2026
position_start: Predecessor programme Tech pour la Mauritanie, closed in 2025
position_end: Running for 2,150 beneficiaries across six cities, about 2,000 of them young people, financed by France's Fonds Equipe France and implemented by Simplon
note: the implementer puts its three-year record at about 5,000 people given basic digital skills

subject: capacity.research
name: National digital or data research programme
milestone: CNESRS-accredited under arrêté 183 (17 February 2022) for May 2021 to May 2024; no renewal is on record
position_end: Calcul Scientifique, Informatique et Data Sciences unit at the Faculté des Sciences et Techniques, Université de Nouakchott, with 16 doctoral candidates concentrated in AI and data science (5G optimisation, blockchain/IoT process mining, health-data management, cloud-resource elasticity) and three theses defended in 2022; the accreditation period ended May 2024 with no renewal published

subject: data.statistics
name: Fifth general population and housing census
milestone: Final regional results presented from 3 August 2026
position_end: Conducted entirely electronically for the first time - mapping, collection, processing and analysis all digital - with final results presented at regional workshops from August 2026
note: The all-electronic claim is the statistics agency's own; no methodology document is held.

subject: data.statistics
name: National Youth Empowerment Index
milestone: Reference document presented at a Nouakchott workshop, 29 July 2026
position_end: Published in preliminary form at 60.5 out of 100 for 2026, across five domains built from 43 secondary indicators, education and training strongest at 69.5% and health and sport weakest at 46.1%

subject: data.open
name: National open data portal
milestone: National open-data strategy published, June 2023, naming the existing portal and proposing a governance overhaul
position_end: mauritania.opendataforafrica.org, run by ANSADE, carries 24 downloadable datasets from 4 public providers — last of four benchmarked countries (Mauritania, Morocco, Senegal, Tunisia) on every published measure — with no Open Government Partnership membership; a June 2023 strategy proposes a new governance framework, portal redesign and reviving the decree creating an Agence Numérique de l'État as operator, none of which is reported delivered

subject: geopol.china
name: Urban security system
milestone: Chinese government grant of MUR 629.4m through ETCA
position_end: Granted; no delivery, siting or oversight arrangement for the system is on record

subject: geopol.gulf
name: Oman digital cooperation agreement
milestone: Cooperation agreement and memoranda signed at the close of the Nouakchott forum
position_end: Signed, covering digital capacity-building, e-training, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence and data analytics, platform development and civil-service programmes; no value disclosed by either side
